title: Multi-stage reconnaissance and credential attack
summary: Nine events over 48 minutes from ASN 14061 (DigitalOcean). Every event scored P4 in isolation. Correlated, they form a reconnaissance sweep that located an exposed Spring Boot Actuator endpoint on metrics-agent, followed by credential stuffing against auth-service and one successful authentication.

narrative:
Between 09:14 and 10:02 UTC, nine requests reached Sample Store from two addresses inside 185.220.101.0/24 (AS14061, DigitalOcean). No single request was alarming: each scored P4 in isolation, request rates stayed inside normal bounds, and per-account authentication failures never reached the lockout threshold.

Correlated on shared subnet and ASN within a 48-minute window, the pattern is unambiguous. Five requests enumerated sensitive paths (/.env, /.git/config, /wp-admin/, /phpmyadmin/, /actuator/env). The fifth returned HTTP 200: metrics-agent exposes a Spring Boot Actuator environment endpoint, which maps to CVE-2022-22965 — listed in the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalogue with an EPSS score of 0.974. Four further requests attempted authentication against three separate accounts, one attempt each, and the final attempt succeeded against u_8f2a1c from a datacentre address outside that account's normal activity window.

None of the nine requests executed the Adamantine browser sensor, indicating direct API access rather than browser traffic throughout.

This incident shares an ASN, technique set, and timing profile with INC-0142 (23 July, analyst-confirmed malicious) at 87% similarity.
